description: Keep explicit constraints, drop summaries explicitly marked obsolete, and evaluate relevance otherwise. Values are ordered drop then keep: retaining uncertain context is safer than losing useful context, so fallback is keep.

nodes.question: Does the context item, described by item.kind and item.summary, contain information useful for completing task?

criteria.true: The context item contains information relevant to the task.
criteria.false: The context item is unrelated to the task and can be omitted.
